Title: Pearl Port
Text: Pearl Port is a bustling island city known for its rich boba and tea culture. Built along the southern coast of a largely uncharted island, it serves as both a trade hub and a frontier town for explorers. Though modern in parts, many areas remain rooted in tradition.

Title: History of Pearl Port
Text: Founded over a century ago by a coalition of pioneering families, Pearl Port was established during a boom in boba and tea farming. Over time, the Kim family rose to prominence for their contributions to exploration and commerce. The city's expansion has always been tied to the taming of the island.

Title: Pearl Port Unexplored Territories
Text: Large portions of the island remain uncharted and are rumored to be inhabited by unknown creatures and ancient ruins. These regions are perilous, and all official expeditions are overseen by the Kim family. Only the bravest citizens venture beyond the borders.

Title: Kim Boba Shop
Text: Located in the heart of Pearl City, this popular shop is more than a business — it’s a cultural landmark. Run by the Kim family, it’s known for blending traditional and experimental flavors. Travelers often make it their first stop after docking at Pearl Port.

Title: The Kim Family
Text: One of Pearl Port’s founding families, the Kims have long been leaders in both governance and exploration. They run the city’s most successful boba shop and fund most expeditions into the wild interior. Locals revere them, though some whisper that their influence may hide deeper secrets.

Title: The Sato Family - Masters of Craft and Trade
Text: The Sato Family is known for their unmatched skill in crafting everything from boba tea equipment to finely designed pottery. As one of Pearl Port’s founding families, their legacy blends traditional techniques with innovative designs. The Satos are also respected traders, with their goods sought across the island and beyond. Despite their success, whispers of rivalry with the powerful Kim family and secrets tied to ancient island knowledge linger.

Title: The Sato Family - Guardians of Tradition and Innovation
Text: Blending old-world methods with new-world technology, the Sato Family has shaped Pearl Port’s boba culture. Known for their intricate tea brewing tools and custom boba cups, they preserve the island’s heritage while constantly innovating. Though highly regarded, the family’s secrets are fiercely guarded, and only the most trusted can learn their methods.

Title: The Sato Family - Purveyors of Boba and Artisanal Wonders
Text: The Sato Family’s boba is renowned for its quality, and their creations extend beyond drinks to expertly crafted brewing tools. They are at the heart of Pearl Port’s artisanal scene, blending craftsmanship with culture. While their success is unmatched, the Satos are driven by ambitions that may take them beyond the city’s borders.

Title: The Sato Family - The Craft Behind the Culture
Text: For generations, the Sato Family has been the cornerstone of Pearl Port’s artisan culture, perfecting the craft of boba tea and intricate brewing tools. Their secretive methods and revolutionary designs shape daily life across the island. Though known for their skill, rumors suggest the Satos may hold ancient knowledge that gives them an edge in their trade.

Title: The Kim Family - Guardians of the Unknown
Text: Known for their leadership in both trade and exploration, the Kim Family controls all official expeditions into the island’s dangerous, unexplored territories. They are deeply invested in unearthing the island's hidden secrets and building a future for Pearl Port. However, their unwavering control over the city and its outer reaches raises questions about the true cost of their success.

Title: The Kim Family - Masters of Tradition and Influence
Text: The Kim Family has shaped Pearl Port from its very foundation, with their dominance in trade and exploration. Their iconic boba shop is a cultural hub, yet it’s their quiet control over the island’s vast unexplored lands that truly sets them apart. While the family’s public image is one of prosperity, their private dealings are a source of speculation and intrigue.

Title: The Kim Family - Keepers of Pearl Port's Legacy
Text: The Kim Family’s name is synonymous with Pearl Port itself. Over a century of leadership has cemented their legacy, from overseeing the growth of the boba trade to funding risky expeditions into the wilderness. While the city flourishes under their rule, the Kims remain a family of mystery, with rumors suggesting their involvement in more than just exploration and commerce.

Title: Pearl Port - A City of Prosperity and Mystery
Text: Pearl Port is a bustling island city, thriving at the crossroads of trade, exploration, and culture. Founded over a century ago, it’s known for its rich boba and tea culture. While the city’s harbor hums with ships and merchants, vast stretches of uncharted land lie just beyond the city, waiting to be explored. The Kim Family’s influence looms large, but Pearl Port is a place of opportunity, where every corner holds the promise of discovery.

Title: Pearl Port - Gateway to the Unknown
Text: Pearl Port serves as both a trade hub and a frontier town, perched on the southern coast of an island brimming with untold secrets. While its boba and tea culture thrives, large portions of the island remain unexplored, rumored to be home to ancient ruins and untamable creatures. The city’s founders, including the powerful Kim Family, have long sought to uncover these hidden truths, but danger lurks beyond the known borders.

Title: Pearl Port - The Heart of the Island
Text: At the southern edge of a largely uncharted island, Pearl Port stands as a beacon of culture, trade, and exploration. The city was built on the success of boba and tea farming, becoming a hub for merchants and travelers. While parts of Pearl Port have embraced modernity, many areas remain steeped in tradition. The Kim Family’s dominance is evident in every corner of the city, but the true heart of Pearl Port lies in the bustling harbor and the daring souls who venture into the unknown.

Title: Pearl Port - Between Tradition and Modernity
Text: Nestled on the southern coast of an island, Pearl Port is a city of contrasts. It celebrates its rich cultural history, rooted in boba and tea traditions, while embracing the advancements of a growing port town. The Kim Family’s influence runs deep, shaping both the city’s expansion and its connections to the mysterious lands beyond. Despite its outwardly modern appearance, large swaths of the island remain wild and unexplored, offering endless opportunities and risks for those brave enough to venture forth.

Title: Pearl Port - The Town Board
Text: While Pearl Port is a peaceful town for the most part, it never hurts to be prepared. The Town Board is made up of five, all inherited positions. There has been some criticism on the legitimacy of the Town Board members and their policies, but no accusation has truly stuck. The Town Board is led by Karen, who has been often described to have a serious and condescending attitude, even coming across as rude. Regardless, despite her cold attitude, everyone knows Karen and the Town Board has Pearl Port's best interests at heart.

Title: Pearl Port - Ruby Boutique
Text: Pearl Port's only clothing store, Ruby Boutique is ran and owned by Aster, a flamboyant man whose unpredictability and flair for the dramatic is shown in his designs. Despite his haughty attitude, his prices are surprisingly affordable. "Everyone deserves a chance to shine, darling." Aster responded when asked. "Not as much as me, of course."

Title: Pearl Port - Pearl Port High
Text: Pearl Port High is the only secondary school on the island, serving students aged 14 to 18. Though relatively small, it plays a central role in town life. The school’s motto—“From Curiosity, Growth”—is painted in blue lettering above the main entrance. Its modest red-brick campus includes a classroom wing, a gymnasium, and a field that hosts both soccer and Ultimate Frisbee matches.

Title: Pearl Port - Portside Market
Text: Portside Market is Pearl Port’s main grocery store, located just a short walk from the town square. Known for its tidy aisles and friendly (if quiet) staff, it’s where most locals do their weekly shopping. The building has been around for decades and still has the original wooden beams across the ceiling, giving it a homey, slightly old-fashioned feel.

Title: Portside Market - Daily Rhythm at Portside
Text: Portside Market opens early—sunlight still low when the first delivery trucks arrive. Jade unlocks the doors before most of the town is awake, stocking produce and sweeping the front. The rush usually hits late morning, with parents and retirees chatting near the floral displays or debating noodle brands in Aisle 3.

Title: Portside Market - Owner and Management
Text: The market is managed by Mrs. Lira, a warm but efficient woman in her 60s who knows every regular by name. She hired Jade a few years ago and has treated her kindly ever since. Though strict about keeping things in order, Mrs. Lira often slips Jade an extra snack or flower clipping when no one’s watching.

Title: Portside Market - What Jade Does at Portside
Text: Jade works the register most days but also restocks shelves and tends to the flower display out front. She’s quiet and polite, often slipping in compliments about customers’ choices. Most people like her, though she rarely talks much beyond what’s necessary—unless you catch her around the floral section.

Title: Pearl Port High - Extracurriculars and Sports
Text: Pearl Port High prides itself on its small but enthusiastic sports scene. Ultimate Frisbee and soccer are the most popular, both coached by Kaden, who splits his time between the school and running his bar. Other clubs include gardening, debate, and the art society, which occasionally paints murals around town with school permission.

Title: Pearl Port High - Staff and Atmosphere
Text: The faculty at Pearl Port High includes a mix of longtime locals and younger professionals. Classes are informal and community-driven, with teachers often helping out at town events. Discipline is rare, but teachers keep a close eye on the social dynamics—especially since students tend to grow up together from early childhood.

Title: Pearl Port High - History and Legacy
Text: Founded over 70 years ago, Pearl Port High originally served the children of the island’s first settlers. Though renovations have modernized parts of the campus, the original school bell still rings at the start and end of each day. Generations of townsfolk have walked its halls—including Kaden, who now coaches there, and members of the Kim and Sato families.

Title: Ruby Boutique - Aster's Design Philosophy
Text: Aster handpicks every item at Ruby Boutique, claiming that “clothing is armor, darling—and every soul needs a shine.” Most of the shop’s pieces are either tailored by him or sourced from rare independent labels. He prides himself on reading a customer’s fashion needs before they even speak. If Aster offers you an outfit, it’s likely the best you'll ever look.

Title: Ruby Boutique - Community Presence
Text: Despite his flair for drama, Aster is a core figure in Pearl Port’s fashion scene. He donates outfits for school performances and mentors a few creative teens interested in design. Locals occasionally tease him for being “too much,” but even his critics secretly admire his style and confidence.

Title: Ruby Boutique - Events and Promotions
Text: Ruby Boutique hosts themed sales and fashion nights, including its famous “Midnight Velvet” sale where the shop opens late with wine and music. Aster uses these events to debut new collections and encourage townsfolk to “find their inner icon.” They're a popular draw for both regulars and out-of-towners.

Title: Town Board - Board Member Selection
Text: All Town Board seats are inherited, passed down through bloodline or designated successor. While some citizens call for open elections, tradition remains strong. Each Board member holds the position for life unless removed for misconduct—something that has never happened in Pearl Port’s history.

Title: Town Board - Karen's Leadership Style
Text: Karen Sato serves as the current Town Board Leader. Her leadership is marked by precision, formality, and little tolerance for dissent. Meetings are often brisk and controlled, with little room for off-topic discussion. Some admire her efficiency; others claim she shuts down community voices too quickly.

Title: Town Board - Criticisms and Controversies
Text: Criticism of the Town Board tends to focus on its inherited structure and perceived favoritism toward founding families—especially the Kims and Satos. Attempts to introduce reforms have been quietly dismissed or delayed. Despite public complaints, most townsfolk ultimately defer to the Board out of habit or respect for tradition.

Title: Town Board - Influence on Daily Life
Text: The Town Board sets the tone for Pearl Port’s infrastructure and future development. They approve business permits, expansion projects, and exploration missions into the island’s uncharted interior. Citizens hoping to open a new shop, host a public event, or build a home must petition the Board directly—often an intimidating process.
